, a plumbing and sewer company based at 9100 Plainfield Road in Brookfield, is encouraging homeowners in Chicago's western suburbs to have aging sewer lines inspected before winter sets in.

Many homes in Brookfield and nearby communities still rely on original clay or cast-iron sewer lines. Tree roots and decades of use leave those pipes cracked or partly blocked, and a slow drain in November can become a full backup once the ground freezes and excavation gets harder. Homes with basement fixtures are especially exposed when heavy rain or snowmelt overloads the municipal system.

"Sewer work is much easier to schedule before the ground freezes," said a spokesperson for Suburban Plumbing Experts. "If a homeowner has seen slow drains or gurgling toilets this fall, now is the time to put a camera in the line."

Suburban Plumbing Experts serves Brookfield and surrounding communities across Cook and DuPage counties. Homeowners can schedule a sewer inspection by calling (708) 729-9249.

Suburban Plumbing Experts is a plumbing and sewer company based in Brookfield, Illinois. The company provides sewer line repair and cleaning, flood control systems, water heater service and general plumbing for homes across Chicago's western suburbs.
